title: Shared character motion
summary: Player and Warden share motion requests, momentum resolution and motor collision handling.
note: The motor alone moves the collision body; player fall reactions remain separate from Warden behavior.

title: Shared action lifecycle
summary: Actions share commitment, timing, one buffered follow-up, interruption and cleanup.
note: Accepted actions capture their definitions and pay validated costs when starting.

title: Health, stamina and mana
summary: Per-character resources handle damage, healing, atomic spending and delayed regeneration.
note: Stamina regeneration depends on movement state; flasks use inventory-backed charges.

title: Item catalog and inventory
summary: Shared definitions support owned copies, stacks, charges, movesets and versioned records.
note: Existing sword, two spells and flask use the system. Loot acquisition and a full inventory UI are deferred.

title: Equipment and quick slots
summary: Hand assignments and spell/gadget slots coordinate held, stowed and released equipment.
note: Bow/shield fixtures demonstrate two-handed stowing; bow attacks, blocking, bashing and dual wielding are deferred.

title: Authored item upgrades
summary: Individual items apply authored damage/healing multipliers by upgrade level.
note: Test Grounds exposes sample +1/+2 upgrades. Upgrade currency, crafting and adventure progression are deferred.

title: Animation and appearance system
summary: Physics-owned poses, reusable rig profiles and item animation banks keep visuals aligned with gameplay.
note: UAL is the temporary player model; some actions retain adapters. Final art and replacement animations require review.

title: Fitted damage sensing
summary: Seventeen animated body regions confirm projectile, melee and area contacts on both player appearances.
note: Regions take equal damage. Combat reads the prior physics snapshot; the Warden retains its existing receiver path.

title: Shoulder camera and target lock
summary: Configurable shoulder view, camera collision and target locking support third-person control.
note: Camera preferences persist; targeting and locomotion facing have separate owners.

title: Menus and saved settings
summary: Shared menus provide camera, remappable controls, display settings and staged Apply/Discard behavior.
note: Navigation restores focus and remembers the last settings tab; PS1 effects can be toggled.

title: Test Grounds and diagnostics
summary: Eight lab stations, practice combat, item testing and optional diagnostics exercise the shared player.
note: Fixtures for future abilities do not implement those abilities. Resets rebuild the starter loadout.

title: Soulbound HUD and mana evolution
summary: An editable browser preview demonstrates the reviewed health artwork, Soul reserves and six mana stages.
note: Godot integration, 12-HP balance, kill rewards and gameplay reserves are not implemented.

title: Performance and character scaling
summary: Contact caching, shared validation and prepared combat assets are implemented and release-benchmarked on Iris Xe.
note: Five actors meet matrix p95 targets but spikes remain; ten exceed fitted-motion/combat budgets. Native profiling and full-encounter validation remain.

title: Seeded seamless world generation
summary: A finite procedural world and seamless dungeons use reproducible seeds, guaranteed landmarks and placement rules.
note: The roadmap proposes a 256 × 256 m pilot with 64 m regions; these are test dimensions.

title: World streaming
summary: Off-thread generation, asynchronous resource loading and budgeted activation support regional traversal.
note: Loading-order determinism, safe connectivity and measured boundary costs belong to the generation pilot.

title: Saves, checkpoints and currency recovery
summary: Serialization contracts exist; gameplay saves, checkpoint respawning and recoverable progression currency are planned.
note: Item records round-trip with validation. Disk saves, persistent world changes and safe-load placement are not implemented.

title: Structural collapse
summary: Connected prebuilt pieces lose support, become physical groups and persist significant destruction.
note: Start with one small structure and measured body/collapse limits; terrain remains intact.

title: Adventure content and progression
summary: Quest lines, encounters, loot and broader progression follow the movement and world pilots.
note: Freeform builds and equipment-weight effects are future direction; detailed gameplay rules remain deferred.

title: Walking, running and sprinting
summary: Camera-relative travel uses momentum, reversal braking, slope adaptation and steps up to 0.60 m.
note: Gait cadence and planted contacts follow movement; target-facing lateral/backward travel still uses forward clips.

title: Adaptive forward dive
summary: Forward/no-direction dodge selects a clearance-aware dive with retained travel until contact.
note: Gap and platform crossings are validated; the old dodge hop was removed.

title: Side and backward rolls
summary: Directional rolls start grounded with 0.70 s playback and retain departure speed when leaving an edge.
note: Rolls retain the authored reach, stamina cost and immunity window without a physical hop.

title: Jumping
summary: A fixed 1.2 m jump costs 15 stamina and supports edge grace, input buffering and limited air steering.
note: Compatible attacks and spells remain usable in the air; momentum survives action completion.

title: Falling and landing damage
summary: Impact speed determines soft, damaging and lethal landings using equivalent-height thresholds.
note: Dodge immunity does not prevent fall damage; deep-water entry follows swimming rules.

title: Timed landing roll
summary: A fresh dodge in the final 0.15 s can spend 25 stamina for a roll and halve eligible nonlethal fall damage.
note: Lethal heights never receive the discount; failed heavy cliff dives enter ragdoll.

title: Ragdoll and automatic get-up
summary: Descending hits and lethal landings activate physical ragdoll; survivors recover after settling and clearance checks.
note: Supported get-up uses face-up/down variants; water and blocked-standing crawl recovery have validated fallbacks.

title: Ledge grab, hang and pull-up
summary: Eligible static lips support persistent hanging, clearance-tested pull-ups and deliberate release.
note: Hanging neither drains nor regenerates stamina; pull-up costs 10. Supported landing-height variation is bounded.

title: Sideways hanging and corners
summary: Left/right input moves along validated ledges and rounds inside/outside corners independently of camera orbit.
note: Blocked or unsupported routes retain the last safe hold; this is not free wall climbing.

title: Crouching and low passages
summary: Persistent crouch supports 2 m/s travel, low tunnels and clearance-checked standing transitions.
note: Forward-downhill knee correction is implemented; gait-entry snaps, backward knees and diagonal contact/skin defects remain deferred.

title: Hands-and-knees crawling
summary: Hold crouch for 0.5 s to enter a persistent 1 m/s crawl through the supported 0.90 m passage.
note: Implemented on the UAL player despite older deferred notes. Unsupported animation profiles reject entry; combat and traversal actions are disabled.

title: Surface swimming and water exits
summary: Water entry transitions to floating/swimming, stamina-funded fast strokes and automatic validated ledge exits.
note: Test Grounds station 05 is playable; deep-water entry cancels incompatible actions and landing damage.

title: Underwater diving and swimming
summary: Camera pitch/yaw steer underwater travel; crouch descends, jump ascends and released input holds depth.
note: Underwater combat, currents and moving/wavy water remain deferred; low-roof posture transitions are collision checked.

title: Head-based breath and drowning
summary: Mouth/nose immersion consumes 20 seconds of breath, then applies drowning damage through shared health handling.
note: Breathing follows the completed head pose during crouch, crawl, ledge and ragdoll states; camera tint is independent.

title: Light combos and heavy attacks
summary: Sword attacks use committed timing, stamina costs, hit confirmation and one queued follow-up.
note: Light attacks use native UAL2 A/B clips and recoveries. Tap for light; hold for the interruptible UAL1 Sword_Attack heavy windup.

title: Azure Bolt and Violet Burst
summary: Equipped spells deliver a projectile or area burst with mana costs, windup and recovery.
note: Both allow grounded/airborne casting. Crawling and swimming disallow spells; accepted casts retain their selected-item values.

title: Flask and healing gadgets
summary: Healing actions consume inventory-backed flask charges or the selected gadget's authored supply policy.
note: Stackable potion and reusable charm are testing fixtures; retry/station reset restores starter equipment.

title: Warden encounter and retries
summary: The courtyard boss uses telegraphed combo, overhead and lunge patterns with death/victory and retry flow.
note: The Warden shares action/motion foundations while retaining its own controller and legacy Knight presentation.

title: Sliding
summary: A future slide mechanic will define entry speed, slope response, braking and exits.
note: Controls, animation references and acceptance criteria remain to be agreed before implementation.

title: Free wall climbing
summary: Future climbing includes vertical/lateral wall travel, attachment, corners, release and ledge exits.
note: Existing ledge hanging and water exits provide only part of the traversal foundation.

title: Boss climbing
summary: Shadow of the Colossus-inspired climbing on an articulated giant: marked surfaces, inverted traversal, leaps, resting, bracing and charged weak-point stabs.
note: Planning and technical design are in progress; gameplay implementation and acceptance testing are pending. The full Ultra-agent plan records agreed controls, shared stamina, moving-surface ownership, collision safety, presentation, development gates and validation.

title: Push, carry and throw
summary: Future object handling covers weight, contact, pickup, held state, aiming, release and impact.
note: Laboratory fixtures do not implement these interactions.

title: Powered flight
summary: Permanently unlocked flight will share spell mana and provide takeoff, hover, steering and landing.
note: Mana exhaustion must switch to ordinary falling in the same tick; flight is not currently playable.
